property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, a successful call to setOwner must cause the return value of owner() to equal the supplied _owner argument; the mutant leaves owner() unchanged, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the function body with an empty body, so setOwner does nothing and the owner state variable remains unchanged.
mutated_unit_code: function setOwner(address _owner) public onlyOwner returns (bool success) {}
